Add bounded gzip transport for feature-style bundle imports (#265)

* Add bounded gzip transport for feature-style bundle imports

* test: extend bundle transport business parity coverage

* fix: compile the release compiler without the Flutter barrel

Import the pure Dart compiler modules directly so the native executable
no longer loads aviary_renderer through the core library barrel.

* fix: accept object schemas that omit properties

The generated Baya catalog includes object schemas with no properties map.
Treat that omission as no named fields, and reject a non-map properties
value instead of failing every compiler request or dropping the catalog.

* fix: preserve encoded feature-style change reasons

Percent-decode X-Change-Reason once only when the percent-utf8 marker is
present, and store the decoded reason on the existing import and catalog
audit details.

* docs: record that the release compiler failure is historical

The transport handoff still described the current head as failing on dart:ui.
That failure predates the standalone compiler and catalog fixes.

* test: run feature-style CLI checks with the Dart VM

flutter test resolves Platform.resolvedExecutable to flutter_tester, so the
CLI process waited until the 30s timeout. Spawn the Dart SDK beside that
engine and run from the package root.

* fix: allow the catalog registration audit helper eight arguments

Clippy rejects record_registration after the decoded change reason was
added. Match the existing audit helpers and keep the reason on that call.

* style: format the feature-style client transport test

The repository format check rejects the unwrapped header expectation
and CLI argument list in feature_style_platform_client_test.dart.
